Chapter one — the Zilla Realm

A realm
worth leaving

The Zilla Realm was loud, cracked and permanently on fire. Ash skies. Dead chains. A crown for anyone big enough to take it, and nothing left worth ruling.

Turdzilla was its king of absolutely nothing. Thick skin, gold chain, no kingdom. He had spent his whole life protecting rubble.

Then a seam of gold light tore open above the ash, and through it he saw towers. Banners. A gate. Somewhere that still had something left to lose.

He didn't cross over
to take a throne.
He crossed over to stand in front of one.

Chapter three — the realm of gold

Toezlandia

A kingdom built on gold, good faith and an unreasonable number of feet. Behind the gates: the Vault, the Market, the Tech Labs, the University, and thousands of citizens who have never had to hold a weapon.

STOEZ rules it. PIGSY, PJ and JAZZY keep it standing. And every single day, something crawls out of the dark and tries to take it.

🦶 Home of $TOEZ 👑 House of Stoez 🏰 Under siege
The vow at the gate

The Zillaz did not come to rule Toezlandia

They came to stand in front of it. The realm keeps its crown, its coin and its king. The Zillaz keep the road outside the gate — and everything that comes down it.

One realm has everything worth protecting. The other has everything built for protecting it. That is the whole alliance.

Chapter four — the family

Meet the Zillaz

Turdzilla came first. The rest of them followed, because nobody in that family has ever let one of their own walk into something alone. Different personalities, one dysfunctional family, one mission. Tap any of them.

The Guardian path

Scores reset when a season ends. Guardian XP never does. Every run you play adds to a record that belongs to you.

Standing in the realm

Holding is recognition, not an advantage. Cosmetics, crests and access — never a score multiplier, because a leaderboard where the biggest wallet wins is not a leaderboard.
